name: fireworks
summary: Followed the Fireworks Serverless Quickstart exactly as written. The OpenAI Python SDK was already installed in the sandbox. I created the quickstart.py script verbatim from the docs (using the OpenAI SDK approach with base_url="https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1", model="accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p3-flash", and the FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable). Running the script returned a chat completion: "¡Hola! That's 'hello' in Spanish..." confirming the API call to the Fireworks-hosted model succeeded. No deviations were required.
deviations: None — the quickstart instructions worked exactly as written.
